notes.title: Ghosts 👻
notes.notes: Don't worry, they can't hurt you!

notes.title: Feather Jump Update
notes.notes: Did you just reflexively double jump and spend a feather? Did you regret it? Don't worry, you spit the feathers out of your little butt now, so you can go back and get it if you want!

notes.title: Ground Pound and New SFX
notes.notes:
Ground Pound! Hold "F" (right bumper on controller) while mid air to ground pound!

New sound effects for:
- New height reached
- Enemies getting sliced by platforms
- Player dying (with new music!)
- Entering and exiting the shop

notes.title: Damn it's been almost a month since I posted a build. Sorry!
notes.notes: Some new items and some art for the platforms and a whole bunch of miscellaneous changes.

notes.title: new platforms slice enemies in half
notes.notes: if an enemy is in the way of a new platform as it spawns in, the enemy is sliced in half
